sections.title: What Is an ATS-Friendly Resume?
sections.content:
An ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is recruiting software used by many employers to collect, organize and search applications. An ATS-friendly resume is not a guarantee of passing screening: different systems and employer workflows parse documents differently. The practical goal is to make your information easy for software and people to identify.

Use conventional section headings such as Experience, Education, Skills and Projects; keep dates consistent; use selectable text; and mirror relevant terminology from the job description when it truthfully describes your background. Indeed's current ATS guidance similarly emphasizes clear structure and relevant keywords rather than tricks intended to manipulate a screening system.

For ATS-related searches, avoid promises about beating a bot. The defensible goal is machine-readable, role-relevant information that a recruiter can also scan quickly.

sections.title: Best ATS Resume Format for Indian Freshers
sections.content:
Keep the layout simple enough that the reading order is obvious. A single-column layout is a conservative choice, especially when you do not know which recruiting system will process the file. sections.title: How to Write ATS-Friendly Skills and Projects
sections.content:
